capabilities: Show Chinese popover definitions on hover or double-click
Display Pinyin and Jyutping with pronunciation
Query 21 downloadable offline dictionaries with reverse lookup
Save starred words and review SM-2 flashcards
Analyze HSK difficulty and animate stroke order
disambiguation: Not a general translation plugin; it only handles Chinese and Cantonese lookup, study, and character analysis.
extras: Dictionary packs download from raw.githubusercontent.com / cdn.jsdelivr.net; Google Neural TTS is optional and requires network, offline Web Speech API is the alternative. Author links free video courses. MIT license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Chinese words, hear Mandarin or Cantonese readings, or study saved vocabulary inside notes.
summary: Chinese popover dictionary and language-learning suite with Mandarin and Cantonese readings, offline dictionaries, flashcards, and calligraphy tools.
